title: Binary representation of a remainder
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be the natural numbers decoded from its first and second paired components, respectively. The definition assigns the binary digit list of the natural-number remainder of $a$ upon division by $b$, using natural-number remainder when $b=0$.
